About me

Originally from Bangladesh, now based in London. I moved to the UK to study cyber security and I'm in the second and final year of my MSc.

I want to work in a Security Operations Centre. My MSc work centres on detecting cyber attacks: I'm building a satellite attack simulation testbed to replicate and detect attacks, and my dissertation maps real-world threats to MITRE ATT&CK and SPARTA. Alongside my studies I work in front-line security roles, where I've practised incident reporting, staying alert for long shifts and communicating clearly under pressure.
